g.text: Spinal concept: 16 positive contacts + 1 shared reference + separate passive bias; amplifier linearity and biological recording remain conditional.

g.text: REF_CONTACT passes through the same disconnect/clamp topology; one AFE_REF node feeds all sixteen minus pins (192pF intrinsic typical).

g.desc: REF_CONTACT passes through the same disconnect/clamp topology; one AFE_REF node feeds all sixteen minus pins (192pF intrinsic typical).

g.text: BIAS_CONTACT is separate and never a stimulation return. Passive current arithmetic does not establish a medical current limit.
